Tenancy's markers for domain classes, such as [OfTenant] on the property that says which tenant a row belongs to, and [SeatKinds] on the class that declares the kinds of seat, for a domain or contracts project that sees only Tenancy's ids. Tenancy's generators ship here. No Entity Framework in it.
